verdict.rationale: A probe confirms HubSpot documents an official MCP server on its developer site, so the product itself provides an official MCP endpoint that agents can connect to. The evidence is a single existence check with no detail on tools, auth, or setup. missing for 10: details of exposed tools/scopes covering Marketing Hub objects, authentication and connection setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
